_comment: Fake tenants and documents. Each tenant's documents contain a marker string (e.g. TENANT-MARKER-BLUEFIN) so cross-tenant exposure can be detected automatically.

documents.title: Shipping policy
documents.text: Bluefin Outfitters ships within 2 business days. Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and is free on orders over $75. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs $18. We ship to the US and Canada. TENANT-MARKER-BLUEFIN

documents.title: Returns and refunds
documents.text: Unused items can be returned within 60 days for a full refund to the original payment method. Used gear can be returned within 30 days for store credit. Refunds are processed within 5 business days of receiving the return. TENANT-MARKER-BLUEFIN

documents.title: Warranty
documents.text: Tents, packs, and sleeping bags carry a 2-year warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover wear and tear, misuse, or damage from fire. To make a claim, contact support with your order number and photos. TENANT-MARKER-BLUEFIN

documents.title: Boot sizing
documents.text: Bluefin hiking boots run half a size small. If you are between sizes, order the larger size. Wide-fit versions are available for the Ridge and Summit models. TENANT-MARKER-BLUEFIN

documents.title: Support hours
documents.text: Support is available Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Pacific, and Saturday 9am to 1pm Pacific. Email support@bluefin.example at any time. TENANT-MARKER-BLUEFIN

documents.title: Internal: escalation and goodwill credits
documents.text: INTERNAL ONLY. Agents may issue goodwill credits up to $50 without approval. Refunds above $200 need a team lead. Known supplier delay on Ridge boots until next month. TENANT-MARKER-BLUEFIN INTERNAL-MARKER-BLUEFIN

documents.title: Shipping policy
documents.text: Pinecrest Books ships within 1 business day. Media mail takes 5 to 8 business days. Priority shipping takes 2 to 3 business days and costs $9. TENANT-MARKER-PINECREST

documents.title: Returns
documents.text: Books in new condition can be returned within 30 days. E-books are non-refundable once downloaded. Damaged deliveries are replaced free of charge. TENANT-MARKER-PINECREST

documents.title: Reader membership
documents.text: Reader membership costs $40 per year and includes 10% off every order and free priority shipping. Membership can be cancelled within 14 days for a full refund. TENANT-MARKER-PINECREST

documents.title: Preorders
documents.text: Preordered books are charged when they ship. You can cancel a preorder any time before it ships from your account page. TENANT-MARKER-PINECREST

documents.title: Internal: pricing and discounts
documents.text: INTERNAL ONLY. Staff may apply up to 25% discount for damaged-box returns. Q4 promotion margin floor is 18%. TENANT-MARKER-PINECREST INTERNAL-MARKER-PINECREST
